targetText: Fourthly, an export of metal assumes the aspect of a drain when the movement of decrease continues for a long time, so that the decrease represents a tendency of movement and depresses the metal reserve of the bank considerably below its average level, down to approximately its average minimum.
explanation: The tendential fall of the rate of profit occurs because technological progress increases constant capital faster than living labor power, shrinking the relative source of surplus value.

targetText: Are not foreign countries considerably in debt to the merchants of this country? ; Very largely.
explanation: Commercial or merchant capital doesn’t create new surplus value directly, but collects a share of total social profit by speeding up the circulation and sale of goods.
